description: This file contains unit tests for thread yielding behavior, including performance comparisons between yielding and non-yielding threads, using the Starboard threading API and Google Test framework.

methods.name: IsYielder
methods.description: Determines if a thread index is designated as a yielder for a given trial, alternating to avoid bias.

methods.name: YieldingEntryPoint
methods.description: Thread entry point that yields control repeatedly to test thread scheduling.

methods.name: UnyieldingEntryPoint
methods.description: Thread entry point that does not yield, used for comparison in scheduling tests.
